name: Makhato Ar Sheibani
original_name: マハト=アル・シェイバニ
source:
Star Sign: Virgo
Image Stone: Jade, Emerald

A Holy Knight whose specialty is earth magic.
A kind, sociable and refined person. A good listener who often gives the other knights advice.
He's the third son of one of the seven influential families and there was a bit of a quarrel about which brother should be nominated to the Holy Knights, he won out because of his kindness and natural virtue.
